debt_items.ROOT_CAUSE: The runtime cohort projection was built from the semantic normalization table before offer-level lineage became a runtime admissibility contract.
debt_items.PRODUCT_IMPACT: A user can receive an empirical range whose underlying observations cannot all be replayed to preserved RAW.
debt_items.DATA_RISK: Unverifiable or incorrectly extracted legacy rows can contribute to runtime statistics.
debt_items.SAFETY_RISK: Non-auditable economic evidence can appear usable even when its source cannot be reproduced.
debt_items.BLAST_RADIUS: All runtime cohorts and all public pricing responses that expose evidence.
debt_items.PROPOSED_FIX: Add a fail-closed runtime cohort lineage projection containing constituent observation_id, source_id, offer identity status, raw_document_id/hash and claim provenance; exclude or explicitly downgrade rows that do not satisfy the selected admissibility policy.

debt_items.NOTES: Missing evidence remains legitimate UNKNOWN; the debt is allowing it to participate in a runtime range without disclosing or enforcing that state.

debt_items.ROOT_CAUSE: Legacy semantic normalization stores source/provider location, while the runtime statistics builder reuses that field as the market key without an offer reach contract.
debt_items.PRODUCT_IMPACT: Local evidence may be shown for a province the provider is located in but has not explicitly declared serving.
debt_items.DATA_RISK: Provider geography and service geography become indistinguishable downstream.
debt_items.SAFETY_RISK: A geographically non-comparable offer can enter a range.
debt_items.PROPOSED_FIX: Introduce an explicit reach-to-market admission rule that consumes offer-level geographic_reach; keep unknown reach excluded or insufficient and never infer containment from provider location.
debt_items.REGRESSION_TEST_REQUIRED: Provider location with UNKNOWN reach must not enter a local cohort; explicit exact reach must enter; remote must not imply national.
debt_items.NOTES: No containment heuristic is proposed. Exact conservative matching remains the target.

debt_items.ROOT_CAUSE: Early collectors optimized for batch continuation and counters before a typed acquisition failure contract existed.
debt_items.PRODUCT_IMPACT: Operators cannot distinguish network, parse, auth, schema or persistence failures from one failed count.
debt_items.DATA_RISK: Repeated empty acquisitions can be mistaken for no market evidence.
